title: Transferable Self-Evolving Playbooks for Agentic Security Auditing
problem: Security auditors lack reusable procedures for finding and validating exploitable vulnerabilities.
assumption_broken: Audit expertise need not be manually curated or remain tied to a strong model.
operational_signature: Execute → evaluate → abstract failures → revise → select → transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: Grounded failure reports drive revisions of an external audit playbook while model and harness stay fixed.
limitations_evident: Restricted to locally reproducible high-severity vulnerabilities
Repositories overlap across temporal splits
Single LLM scoring judge

title: REFLEX: Reflective Evolution from LLM Experience
problem: Program evolution entangles visual failure diagnosis with code repair and loses reusable snippets across campaigns.
assumption_broken: Reusable evolutionary knowledge need not remain embedded in whole programs.
operational_signature: Observe → diagnose → retrieve → rewrite → evaluate → credit
load_bearing_mechanism: A separate visual Critic guides an Actor using executable skills credited by child-parent fitness changes.

improver_modified.how: The skill library and operator utilities adapt using measured mutation outcomes.

limitations_evident: Low-dimensional control and one engineering task
No benefit at the smallest call budget
Transfer tested on two source-target pairs

title: daVinci-kernel: Co-Evolving Skill Selection, Summarization, and Utilization via RL for GPU Kernel Optimization
problem: Kernel optimization libraries become stale as the generating policy improves.
assumption_broken: Skill retrieval and summarization need not remain fixed auxiliary components during policy training.
operational_signature: Retrieve → generate → execute → summarize → verify → jointly train
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint reinforcement learning aligns skill selection, utilization, and summarization while execution gates library additions.

improver_modified.how: Shared backbone weights for selection, generation, and summarization are jointly updated by reinforcement learning.

limitations_evident: Evaluation limited to KernelBench
Verification reuses the originating task
Some skill-free ablations outperform on loose thresholds

title: SkillWiki: A Living Knowledge Infrastructure for Agent Skills
problem: Growing agent skill collections lack provenance, governance, and systematic maintenance infrastructure.
assumption_broken: Skills need not be static repository entries managed independently of their evidence and execution history.
operational_signature: Ingest → extract → validate → release → monitor → repair
load_bearing_mechanism: A provenance-linked lifecycle routes execution-triggered skill changes through auditable versioned governance.
limitations_evident: No systematic very-large-repository evaluation
Downstream agent benchmark impact not evaluated
Long-term evolution stability untested

title: When Rules Learn: A Self-Evolving Agent for Legal Case Retrieval
problem: Legal query rewriting rules require expertise and naive combinations fail to reliably improve BM25 retrieval.
assumption_broken: Rewriting rules and their combinations can be learned through experiments rather than fixed by experts.
operational_signature: Generate → combine → evaluate → consult history → eliminate → select
load_bearing_mechanism: An agent uses historical recall measurements to plan rule combinations and conservatively eliminate rules by consensus.
limitations_evident: Only one Chinese legal retrieval benchmark
Small core models do not consistently beat greedy selection
New rule quality does not improve monotonically

title: SEAGym: An Evaluation Environment for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
problem: Final task scores obscure harness overfitting, regressions, transfer, and evolution costs.
assumption_broken: A single sequential score curve is insufficient to establish reusable self-improvement.
operational_signature: Roll out → update → freeze → assess transfer → replay → record costs
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate frozen validation, ID, OOD, and replay views evaluate persistent harness snapshots without changing native update rules.
limitations_evident: Only Terminal-Bench and text-only HLE sources
No model-weight evolution experiments
Cross-model harness transfer is asymmetric

title: OPD-Evolver: Cultivating Holistic Agent Evolver via On-Policy Distillation
problem: Memory agents retain experience without learning coordinated selection, execution, writing, and maintenance competence.
assumption_broken: Memory lifecycle abilities can be trained together instead of treated as fixed infrastructure.
operational_signature: Retrieve → act → write → attribute utility → distill hindsight → maintain
load_bearing_mechanism: Outcome-calibrated memory attribution supplies privileged hindsight for on-policy distillation of four memory lifecycle abilities.

improver_modified.how: On-policy self-distillation updates the shared policy that selects, writes, and maintains experience.

limitations_evident: Evaluation permits online memory accumulation
Memory attribution is observational rather than randomized
Training uses privileged hindsight unavailable at deployment

title: FinAcumen: Financial Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Evolving Experience Memory Harness
problem: Stateless financial agents repeatedly rediscover strategies and suffer unreliable tool routing and noisy memory retrieval.
assumption_broken: Retrieved experience should not always condition reasoning; irrelevant memory can be explicitly suppressed.
operational_signature: Sample → grade → distill successes and failures → retrieve → threshold → execute
load_bearing_mechanism: A relevance-gated memory bank supplies successful strategies and failure cautions while falling back when retrieval is weak.
limitations_evident: Nontrivial upfront memory construction cost
English financial benchmarks only
Online accumulation not evaluated

title: EvolveNav: Proactive Preflection and Self-Evolving Memory for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation
problem: Static navigation priors cause repeated mistakes and expensive physical trial and error.
assumption_broken: Training-free navigation can still adapt across episodes through external rules.
operational_signature: Navigate → reflect → extract rules → credit → retrieve → anticipate
load_bearing_mechanism: UCB-weighted experiential rules guide pre-action frontier risk forecasting rather than only post-hoc correction.
limitations_evident: Persistent visual detection errors propagate
Unconventional layouts can cause exploration loops
Memory evolves during evaluation episodes

title: SAGE: Stochastic Prompt Optimization via Agent-Guided Exploration
problem: Prompt optimization lacks deep error diagnosis and can overfit noisy evaluations.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimization is black-box search rather than genuine textual gradient descent, and deeper optimization need not always win.
operational_signature: Export traces → diagnose with code → investigate → rewrite → validate → promote
load_bearing_mechanism: Agents execute diagnostic analyses to ground prompt revisions in measured error patterns.
limitations_evident: No strategy wins across benchmarks
SAGE can overfit training accuracy
Retention is a proxy rather than clinical outcome

title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
problem: Real-world policy research is bottlenecked by manual resets, verification, and algorithm engineering.
assumption_broken: Coding-agent research can operate on physical robots once reset and verification become repeatable immutable interfaces.
operational_signature: Construct interfaces → reset → execute → verify → edit training → share recipes
load_bearing_mechanism: Automated physical reset and verification close a feedback loop that lets coding agents modify policy-training code autonomously.

improver_modified.how: Agents edit policy improvement algorithms and training infrastructure using robot feedback.

limitations_evident: One-time human-guided environment setup
Robot resources remain underutilized
Fleet token costs grow super-linearly

title: AlphaMemo: Structured Search-Process Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Mining Agents
problem: Alpha search wastes trials on redundant or fragile edits and naive success memory amplifies noisy financial feedback.
assumption_broken: Memory should track context-conditioned edit residuals rather than final factors or absolute quality.
operational_signature: Score parent-edit pairs → generate → parse → backtest → extract differences → update residuals
load_bearing_mechanism: Confidence-gated residual memory corrects a search-ledger prior while reliable negative motifs can veto actions.

improver_modified.how: Online context-motif statistics alter subsequent parent-edit selection and failure vetoes.

limitations_evident: Needs repeated observations before memory becomes informative
Requires executable grammar and standardized feedback
Offline discovery rather than live trading

title: A-Evolve-Training: Autonomous Post-Training of a 30B Model
problem: Frontier-scale autonomous post-training makes noisy trials expensive and drifting experiment state undermines comparability.
assumption_broken: Workers need not inherit previous winners, and internal development gains need not remain authoritative evidence.
operational_signature: Fork fixed substrate → vary recipes → train → aggregate evidence → calibrate proxy → revise search policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Immutable baseline forks preserve comparability while a bounded meta-agent revises the rolling search policy from round-level evidence.

improver_modified.how: The meta-agent revises search axes, promotion thresholds, standing recipes, and dead-end registry under a frozen constitution.

limitations_evident: Single unreplicated campaign
Leaderboard feedback informs search policy
Larger-model runs lack comparable human anchors

title: KBSpec: LLM-driven Formal Specification Generation with Evolving Domain Knowledge Base
problem: LLMs lack specification-language and verifier-specific knowledge needed for correct formal specifications.
assumption_broken: Official documentation alone is insufficient; verifier-compatible knowledge can be learned from repair trajectories without weight updates.
operational_signature: Initialize knowledge → retrieve → generate → verify → repair → retain useful experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Verifier-attributed generation and repair outcomes expand and filter a dual-source knowledge base.
limitations_evident: Evolution programs are mutations of evaluation benchmark programs
Only JML and OpenJML evaluated
SpecGen has higher completeness among passing specifications

title: Safety in Self-Evolving LLM Agent Systems: Threats, Amplification, and Case Studies
problem: Static security evaluations miss adversarial influences inherited through agent evolution.
assumption_broken: Agent compromises need not end with a session because evolution can preserve and amplify them.
operational_signature: Map modules → trace lifecycle → inject cases → inspect persistence → compare defenses
load_bearing_mechanism: A module-by-lifecycle attack-surface matrix exposes persistent cross-generation threats and evolution-path defense bypasses.
limitations_evident: Case studies limited to two frameworks
Condensed text omits detailed case-study protocol
Threat taxonomy exceeds empirically demonstrated coverage

title: PixJail: Self-Evolving Paper-to-Pipeline Reproduction for Text-to-Image Jailbreak Evaluation
problem: T2I jailbreak results are hard to reproduce because attack and evaluation pipeline choices interact.
assumption_broken: Reproducing attack code alone is insufficient without reconstructing the full evaluation protocol.
operational_signature: Parse paper → retrieve experience → specify → implement → audit → archive
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared typed contract and separate attack/evaluation audit loops reuse versioned reproduction experience.
limitations_evident: Memory ablation uses one method and LLM code-quality judging
All generated evaluation code undergoes manual verification
Heuristic memory matching may miss novel attack families

title: Metis: Bridging Text and Code Memory for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Text memory incurs repeated reasoning while indiscriminate code memory is costly and brittle on unseen tasks.
assumption_broken: Experience representation can be chosen from recurrence evidence rather than fixed at system design time.
operational_signature: Reflect → type experience → retrieve → track reuse → crystallize → validate
load_bearing_mechanism: Recurring textual execution plans are selectively promoted into validated callable tools while other experience remains flexible text.
limitations_evident: Only AppWorld evaluated
Unseen-application test-challenge excluded
Construction costs exclude trajectory generation

title: The Red Queen Gödel Machine: Co-Evolving Agents and Their Evaluators
problem: Fixed evaluation criteria limit recursive agent improvement and cannot adapt to evaluator blind spots.
assumption_broken: The evaluation objective can evolve alongside task agents while staying stationary within each epoch.
operational_signature: Expand archive → evaluate → anchor challengers → replace evaluator → erase dependent scores → resume
load_bearing_mechanism: Ground-truth-anchored evaluator replacement with selective erasure permits controlled non-stationary search utilities.

improver_modified.how: Search edits the meta-agent and evaluators, replacing evaluator slots at epoch boundaries.

limitations_evident: Writers and provers lack objective ground-truth anchors
Evaluator validity is epoch-local
Anchor benchmarks can limit evaluator improvement

title: AgentX: Towards Agent-Driven Self-Iteration of Industrial Recommender Systems
problem: Industrial recommendation experiment throughput remains limited by human idea-to-launch engineering.
assumption_broken: Production experiment experience can improve the development agents themselves rather than only the recommender.
operational_signature: Ground proposals → implement → verify → deploy → judge → distill harness updates
load_bearing_mechanism: Online A/B outcomes and failure traces feed semantic-gradient harness updates admitted through paired replay.

improver_modified.how: SGPO updates individual subagent specifications from accumulated execution trajectories.

limitations_evident: Human review remains in proposal and rollout gates
Production results cover a three-week window
Condensed text omits harness evolution evaluation details

title: QueenBee Planner: Skill-Evolving Communication Topologies for Token-Efficient LLM Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Topology optimizers fail to accumulate reliable reusable communication-design knowledge.
assumption_broken: Communication architecture can be a reusable learned skill while workers and graders remain fixed.
operational_signature: Generate graph → execute → attribute motifs → falsify insights → gate updates → retrieve rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Held-out, variance-aware validation converts communication motifs into Preserve, Modify, or Avoid design rules.

improver_modified.how: The planner's design-rule bank evolves and conditions future graph generation.

limitations_evident: Silo evaluation described as incomplete
Independent evolution-run variance remains pending
Small distributed aggregation task suites

title: Agentic Hardware Design as Repository-Level Code Evolution
problem: Plausible one-shot RTL generation fails to satisfy executable hardware design constraints.
assumption_broken: Hardware artifacts themselves can be evolved as versioned repositories with executable acceptance gates.
operational_signature: Compile harness → edit workspace → simulate → inspect failures → repair → commit
load_bearing_mechanism: A persistent git-native agent loop repeatedly repairs hardware artifacts against executable benchmark feedback.
limitations_evident: Final scoring uses the visible repair harness
One benchmark mismatch excluded from completion claim
No physical-design quality-of-results optimization

title: EvoRec: Self Evolving Agentic Recommender Systems
problem: Manual recommender iteration and static agent methodologies constrain optimization to familiar directions.
assumption_broken: Optimization methodology can evolve alongside recommendation models rather than remain fixed.
operational_signature: Propose → edit → train → evaluate → persist → distill methodology
load_bearing_mechanism: Periodic cross-round distillation of balanced success and failure records updates reusable research, engineering, and diagnosis skills.

improver_modified.how: The Skill Evolver merges, refines, and creates methodology skills used by later optimization agents.

limitations_evident: Offline selection split not clearly separated
Online evaluation lasts seven days
Cross-task skill transfer left for future work

title: Recursive Self-Evolving Agents via Held-Out Selection
problem: Context evolution can distract capable agents and cause catastrophic benchmark-specific regressions.
assumption_broken: Reliability depends more on a strict held-out commit gate than on the particular natural-language artifact.
operational_signature: Roll out → rewrite state → validate → retain nonregression → freeze strict best → test
load_bearing_mechanism: Strict best-state updates on disjoint validation preserve an empty-state fallback when evolved context fails to help.
limitations_evident: Small transfer evaluation sets and one split seed
Live web retrieval adds noise
Validation nonregression does not guarantee test safety

title: Evidence-Driven LLM Agent for C-to-Synthesizable-C Conversion and Verification
problem: Standard C conversion fails across synthesis and co-simulation because raw logs poorly localize repair causes.
assumption_broken: Repair knowledge need not remain a static rule book or expose full verification traces to the model.
operational_signature: Generate → verify → localize → retrieve → repair → audit → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Progressive mismatch localization supplies narrowly scoped runtime evidence and family-routed repair cards to the repair loop.

improver_modified.how: Human-audited repair chains enrich the repair-card pool used to guide subsequent repairs.

limitations_evident: Single Vitis toolchain
Control-heavy designs remain difficult
Repair-card construction and evaluation separation unclear

title: Self-Supervised Theorem Discovery in a Formal Axiomatic System
problem: Formal proof discovery depends on human theorem libraries and struggles to autonomously discover reusable lemmas.
assumption_broken: Useful proof primitives can emerge from axioms and self-generated trajectories without human proof corpora.
operational_signature: Explore → relabel → train → filter → rank → expand → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: General theorems that the current policy cannot reliably reprove become single-step lemma actions for later generations.

improver_modified.how: Each generation retrains a goal-conditioned proof policy over an expanded action space of discovered lemmas.

limitations_evident: Single propositional Hilbert system
LLM evaluations are single-shot
Scaling to richer formal systems untested

title: Self-Evolving Agentic Image Restoration via Deliberate Planning and Intuitive Execution
problem: Greedy restoration planning loses long-horizon quality and repeatedly discards expensive successful search trajectories.
assumption_broken: Restoration experience can become verified reusable execution expertise rather than transient per-image search.
operational_signature: Diagnose → retrieve → execute → gate → search → judge → consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Degradation-indexed episodic memory reuses high-reward trajectories under an outcome gate with tree-search fallback.
limitations_evident: Fixed restoration tool library
Diagnosis errors impair memory routing
Cold-start tree search overhead

title: Experience Graphs: The Data Foundation for Self-Improving Agents
problem: Long-horizon agent search produces experience that ephemeral logs cannot reliably recover, query, share, or materialize for training.
assumption_broken: Agent exploration state should be governed database state rather than process-local memory or disposable checkpoints.
operational_signature: Explore → evaluate → persist → query → retrieve → reuse → materialize
load_bearing_mechanism: A durable reward-bearing experience graph makes cross-session reuse and frontier selection database access patterns.
limitations_evident: Condensed text omits detailed evaluation protocol
Training flywheel described architecturally
Production example centers on kernel optimization

title: TacEvo: Self-Evolving Architecture Discovery for Robotic Tactile Perception via LLM-Driven Quality-Diversity Search
problem: Expert-designed tactile networks and fixed NAS spaces limit architectural novelty and diversity.
assumption_broken: Executable network code can be searched openly while preserving multiple quality-diversity niches.
operational_signature: Sample → mutate → validate → train → map → replace → diversify
load_bearing_mechanism: CVT MAP-Elites preserves diverse high-fitness architectures across structural and efficiency descriptors.

improver_modified.how: Generation temperature adapts to archive progress, although recorded prompt fitness does not control mutation-prompt sampling.

limitations_evident: Single tactile sensor and two small datasets
No matched alternative NAS search
Prompt archive records rather than selects mutation prompts

title: ManimAgent: Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents for Visual Education
problem: Animation agents discard transferable success and repair experience between paper-section tasks.
assumption_broken: Reflection traces can yield persistent positive exemplars and explicit negative constraints without weight updates or human seeds.
operational_signature: Retrieve → generate → render → critique → revise → gate → distill
load_bearing_mechanism: Separately gated success rationales and validated failure transitions populate dual memory channels with distinct prompt roles.
limitations_evident: Only Manim and English scientific sections
Weak VLM-human agreement
No paraphrase deduplication or memory capacity bound

title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
problem: Frozen world models provide unreliable foresight that can harm agent action selection under deployment shifts.
assumption_broken: World-model adaptation can revise contextual evidence rather than model weights or the downstream agent.
operational_signature: Predict → gate → act → observe → compare → revise → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Executed-action-aligned mismatches update semantic rules while episodic retrieval grounds predictions and confidence gates their exposure.
limitations_evident: Only two controlled text environments
Confidence requires token probabilities
Gains over no-foresight baseline are mixed for stronger model
